title: Single-lattice covering density of order n log n
exact_target: Does an absolute $C>0$ exist such that, for every $n\geq 2$ and convex body $K\subset R^{n}$, some full-rank lattice $\Lambda $ satisfies $K+\Lambda =R^{n}$ and $vol_n(K)/det\Lambda \leq Cn$ log n? No symmetry, smoothness or normalization of K is assumed.
